svg.title: ViFi one-time customer-care SMS opt-in flow
svg.desc: After a fresh phone-follow-up request, the initial disclosure record cannot authorize SMS. The voice instruction says: After this message ends, to opt in, text YES within 15 minutes to this ViFi number: [ViFi SMS number]. Only after the full voice disclosure finishes and activation succeeds does a 15-minute window open. An exact YES sent during that window to the identified ViFi-owned SMS number authorizes one opt-in confirmation and one fixed ViFi customer-care receipt. ViFi sends no SMS before an accepted YES. A YES during playback, late, replayed, or unsolicited sends nothing. STOP applies globally to the ViFi program and HELP provides ViFi support. Before approval, the public evidence and this diagram are the reviewer proof. All outbound remains disabled until the Campaign is VERIFIED; after verification, outbound is enabled only for one consented internal canary, and customer-provisioned numbers remain disabled until it passes.
svg.text: ViFi Customer-Care SMS Opt-In Flow
ZERO outbound SMS before the consumer texts YES
Step 1 — Fresh phone-follow-up request and ViFi voice disclosure
ViFi will send two messages for this one-time request: an opt-in confirmation
and one customer-care receipt. After this message ends, to opt in,
text YES within 15 minutes to this ViFi number: [ViFi SMS number].
Consent is optional and is not a condition of purchase.
ViFi sends no text before your YES. Message and data rates may apply.
Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for help.
Terms are at vifi dot us slash legal slash terms.
Privacy is at vifi dot us slash legal slash privacy.
[ViFi SMS number] is dynamically replaced only with a ViFi-owned SMS-capable source.
Pre-approval reviewer proof = public evidence + this diagram; no public SMS enrollment.
Step 2 — Activated 15-minute YES window
Only after the full disclosure finishes and activation succeeds can YES authorize.
The first exact YES within 15 minutes consumes the pending request and triggers two messages.
YES during playback, late, replayed, or unsolicited sends nothing.
Step 3 — Confirmation registered at Campaign submission
ViFi: Opt-in confirmed. You will receive one requested follow-up text.
Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help or STOP to opt out.
Sent only after the timely, accepted inbound YES.
Step 4 — One fixed ViFi customer-care receipt
ViFi: Your one-time phone follow-up request has been recorded.
Reply HELP for help or STOP to opt out. Msg & data rates may apply.
No variables, customer names, links, phone numbers, free-form text, or recurring messages.
Complete after the one receipt
No reminder, marketing, free-form reply, or message series.
STOP = global ViFi suppression
No program number may bypass the opt-out.
START/UNSTOP, then fresh request + timely YES.
HELP = ViFi support
support@vifi.us · STOP remains available
No duplicate application-generated auto-reply.
Outbound disabled until VERIFIED · then internal canary only · customer numbers after pass.
